title: C++20 O(1) LRU Cache with TTL Expiration
prompt:
Implement `template <typename K, typename V> class TTLLRUCache` in `lru_cache.hpp` (C++20, header-only).

Required API and semantics:
- `explicit TTLLRUCache(size_t capacity)` and `size_t capacity() const noexcept`.
- `void put(const K& key, V value, int64_t ttl_ms, int64_t now_ms = 0)`:
  - Inserts or updates `key` with `value` expiring at `expiry_ms = now_ms + ttl_ms`.
  - An entry is expired whenever `query_now_ms >= expiry_ms`.
  - If `capacity == 0`, stores nothing.
  - If `ttl_ms <= 0`, the entry is already expired at `now_ms`: remove `key` if it currently exists and do not store it.
  - If `key` already exists (and `ttl_ms > 0`), overwrite its value and `expiry_ms` and promote it to most-recently-used (MRU).
  - When inserting a new key at capacity, evict expired entries (at `now_ms`) before evicting any live entry; if still at capacity, evict the least-recently-used (LRU) live entry.
- `std::optional<V> get(const K& key, int64_t now_ms)`:
  - O(1) lookup. If `key` is missing or expired (`now_ms >= expiry_ms`), remove the expired entry if present and return `std::nullopt`.
  - Otherwise promote `key` to MRU and return its value.
- `bool erase(const K& key)`:
  - Removes `key` if stored in the cache and returns `true`, or `false` if not present.
- `size_t purge_expired(int64_t now_ms)`:
  - Removes all currently stored entries with `expiry_ms <= now_ms` and returns the number of entries removed by this call.
- `size_t size(int64_t now_ms)`:
  - Returns the exact count of non-expired entries at `now_ms`.

Performance requirement: `get` must be O(1) and `put`/`purge_expired` must avoid O(N) full-cache scans on un-expired entries (50,000 mixed operations at capacity 4,096 must finish well under 500ms). Ensure clean C++20 compilation under `/W4` or `-Wall -Wextra`.
